rules.statement: A court may reserve a right of mortgage to the plaintiff even if the sale was fraudulent and collusive, provided it avoids the fraud and places the parties in statu quo.
rules.supporting_quote: Civil Courts interfere in cases of fraud from a civil and not a criminal point of view. It is not their function to punish the wrong doer. Their function is to avoid the fraud and thereafter, as far as it is possible to do so, to place the wrong doer and the person or persons he has wronged or attempted to wrong in statu quo.

meta.parties: Kandiah Et Al. v. Sivakanupillai Et Al
